paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the NDCG@10 scores for four different approaches – “Ours”, “- critiquing”, “- scoring”, and “- ranking” – evaluated on the INSPIRED dataset. The horizontal axis displays the names of the approaches, ordered alphabetically from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 score, ranging from 0.00 to 0.25, with increments of 0.01. The value axis is linear, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.01. The “Ours” bar is colored yellow and extends to a height of approximately 0.22, while the “- critiquing” bar is colored blue and reaches approximately 0.19. The “- scoring” bar is also blue, with a height of approximately 0.16, and the “- ranking” bar is blue with a height of approximately 0.11. All bars are sorted in descending order according to their NDCG@10 score, with “Ours” having the highest score and “- ranking” having the lowest.
